import sys

def gcd(a, b):
    min_v = min(a, b)
    max_v = max(a, b)
    
    while min_v:
        temp = max_v % min_v
        max_v = min_v
        min_v = temp
    
    return max_v

def lcm(a, b):
    return (a * b) // gcd(a, b)

def fast_exp_pow(base, exp, mod):
    res = 1
    
    while exp:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % mod
        
        exp >>= 1
        base = (base * base) % mod
    
    return res

MAXN = 1000000007
SIZE = 1000010

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    
    P = int(data[0])
    K = int(data[1])
    
    Parent = list(range(SIZE))
    Rank = [1] * SIZE
    
    def find_parent(nd):
        if Parent[nd] != nd:
            Parent[nd] = find_parent(Parent[nd])
        return Parent[nd]
    
    def union(nd1, nd2):
        if Rank[nd1] >= Rank[nd2]:
            Parent[nd2] = nd1
            Rank[nd1] += 1
        else:
            Parent[nd1] = nd2
            Rank[nd2] += 1
    
    for i in range(1, P):
        Parent[i] = i
        Rank[i] = 1
    
    for i in range(1, P):
        value = (K * i) % P
        Pa = find_parent(i)
        Pb = find_parent(value)
        
        if Pa != Pb:
            union(Pa, Pb)
    
    groups = set()
    for i in range(1, P):
        groups.add(find_parent(i))
    
    if K == 0:
        ways = fast_exp_pow(P, P-1, MAXN)
    elif K == 1:
        ways = fast_exp_pow(P, P, MAXN)
    else:
        ways = fast_exp_pow(P, len(groups), MAXN)
    
    print(ways)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
